## Problem

`pytest_sessionfinish`'s working-tree backstop in `tests/conftest.py` prints:

    "REPO ISOLATION FAILURE: the test run left new changes in the checkout "
    "(a test wrote into the working tree instead of tmp_path). Offending entries ..."

It is the third member of the shared-checkout guard family, and it makes the same causal
claim its two siblings have now had corrected. Its only evidence is two
`git status --porcelain` snapshots taken around the whole session, so "a test wrote into the
working tree" is exactly the attribution a snapshot diff cannot supply — a concurrent commit,
rebase, branch switch, or editor save by another process in the same checkout produces an
identical diff. `docs/local-dev-env.md` (lines 425-450) already documents that these guards
misfire that way.

Milder than its siblings: it prescribes NO destructive remedy, so nothing here can destroy a
developer's work. The defect is confined to the false causal claim and to the word "Offending".

## Prior art

- `tests/_isolation.py::leak_failure_message`, corrected under `746c-185a-0e48-4b83`.
- `tests/_isolation.py::head_move_failure_message`, corrected under `a991-09dd-aa6a-4a27`
  (which is where this was found; the HEAD-move guard's remedy was the dangerous case and was
  fixed first, keeping that change tight).

Both extract the text into `tests/_isolation.py` so it can be pinned on observable content.
The same treatment applies: name the concurrent-external possibility instead of asserting the
one cause the backstop cannot know, and pin it alongside the existing assertions in
`tests/unit/test_external_mutation_diagnostics.py`.

## Scope

Wording only. The backstop must keep failing the run exactly as it does now (it still escalates
`session.exitstatus` so CI catches a genuine leak) — this is not a weakening of detection.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The backstop message no longer asserts that a test made the change; it names the
      concurrent-external cause, mirroring `leak_failure_message`.
- [x] The text lives in `tests/_isolation.py` so it is assertable on observable content.
- [x] A test pins the property alongside the existing ones in
      `tests/unit/test_external_mutation_diagnostics.py`.
- [x] The backstop still sets `session.exitstatus` to a failure on a genuine leak (pinned by a
      test), and `make lint` / `make typecheck` pass.
